stack: Existing Django templates, CSS and JavaScript; SQLite and local Ollama retained
changes: Permission-scoped module/project selectors, navigation, breadcrumbs and working help/user menus
Task explorer: status counters, module tabs, real filters/search, sorting, 25-row database pagination, column preferences, row selection and safe filtered/selected CSV
Checklist evidence split pane, answer/evidence status separation, search, field links, keyboard/pointer resize, mobile drawer
Photo viewer next/previous/zoom, lazy paged thumbnails, available capture/GPS/uploader metadata, existing AI proposal/manual confirmation controls
Validated per-user/task filtered return context and scroll restoration

core.password_hashing: Synthetic test-process-only MD5 override; actual production password hashes unchanged

tests.data_preservation: Seven existing business table comparisons, account identities/password hashes/roles and 78 original SHA256 hashes unchanged

limitations: No contractor, due date or independent site-name field exists; no schema invented
No new bulk workflow transitions or permanent original-photo deletion were introduced; only existing authorized workflow and evidence-link actions are exposed
Existing review forms remain the decision authority; partial approval only where legacy workflow supports it
205-photo browser check is synthetic and is not a 400-photo inference/30-minute benchmark
No separate persisted photo comment field exists; available remarks and metadata retain their existing meaning

runtime.ollama: Existing qwen3.5:4b reports vision; worker capability verification preserved
